rule: Legacy is the oracle (docs/decisions.md). Its resume banner (#67: src/game-loop.js loadSavedDive, _updateResumeBanner, resumeSavedDive, discardSavedDive; src/diving-simulator.html; src/style.css; the strings in src/constants.js) offers a save no more than an hour old on the gas setup without blocking it. restoreDiveState() writes diveMode, gfLow, gfHigh, amvRate, tanks and ccrState into the globals the gas setup is drawn from, and resetDive() starts the next dive with every open-circuit cylinder full and a rebreather's oxygen and diluent where the last dive left them. One departure is recorded in docs/decisions.md (#191, pre-review pass 1 of #250): Start ends the offer, where legacy leaves its strip over the new dive. The save keeps v16, because legacy's fill pressure is totalGas over volume (createTank, gsAdjustPressure, gsAdjustTankVol in src/state.js) and the save's startGasL is that totalGas.
change: src/app/setup/resume-banner.ts builds the banner, a named region with Resume and Discard, from the catalogue's setup.resume.* in English and German. src/app/setup/setup-screen.ts places it first in the panel, where it scrolls with the controls, while a save is on offer, and on Discard drops it and focuses the mode radio. src/app/wreck-app.ts reads the save once when the gate is passed (loadSavedDive, with the legacy seed source of #219), clears one more than an hour old (isSavedDiveExpired), and hands the rest to the setup screen: Resume starts the dive from the save with setupFromSave(save) as its setup, Discard clears both storage keys, and Start begins a new dive on the screen's setup. src/app/setup/resume-setup.ts rebuilds the DiveSetup: mode, factors, consumption, each cylinder at startGasL / volumeL rounded to the screen's 200-300 bar grid, the first cylinder active, the loop's diluent, setpoint and cylinder sizes, and both rebreather cylinders at what the dive left. setupForNextDive gives the game over's retry and the debriefing's dive again a rebreather's oxygen and diluent as the dive left them, for a new and a resumed dive; CcrSetup gains an optional diluentCylinderPressureBar for it, with no control. tests/helpers/start-dive.cjs gains resumeSavedDive and resumeSavedDiveAndWaitForCanvas.

counterChecks.method: Each mutation applied by a script to a file backed up beforehand, the named tests run (for e2e, after rebuilding the client, with --retries=0) under the port lock on the code of 02e37ed. Each file was then restored from its backup and compared with filecmp (shallow=False): byte for byte identical in every case, the working tree clean after the batch, and the client rebuilt from the restored code.
